_note: Editorial seeds for the scandal/drama content thread. Different from curses.json — these need YOU to verify before publishing because they're about real living people and the legal exposure for repeating a false rumour is real. Each entry is a STARTING POINT, not a finished post. The scandal generator in n8n is set up to require manual approval (Telegram or Drive review) before anything publishes.
_legal_disclaimer: Only post claims you can source to a reputable outlet. Frame as 'X reported that...' not 'Y did Z'. Don't repeat allegations involving minors, sexual assault, or criminal matters that haven't been confirmed by police or a court. When in doubt: cut.

seeds.angle: Player bonus disputes are the most reliable pre-tournament drama in football. Nigeria 2022, Cameroon 2014, Ghana 2014 — the pattern is: federation underpays, players threaten to walk, story leaks 48hr before opening match.
seeds.research_prompt: Search recent news for 'bonus dispute' or 'pay row' involving [TEAM] in the last 60 days. The story is usually broken by local sports papers first.
seeds.post_format: Carousel: slide 1 hook ('There's a bonus war breaking out inside [TEAM]'s camp'), slide 2-4 timeline, slide 5 'what it means for the match'.

seeds.angle: Public manager-player friction. Watch for press conferences where a manager declines to name a star in the lineup, or a player skips a session 'for personal reasons'.
seeds.research_prompt: Check the last 14 days of press conferences for [TEAM]. Any unanswered questions about [STAR_PLAYER]? Any 'we'll see' responses to lineup questions? That's the smoke.
seeds.post_format: Carousel: 'Why isn't [PLAYER] starting? — what we know.' Frame as questions, not accusations.

seeds.angle: What's happening inside the camp. Hotel changes, training ground locations, who's rooming with who, who's late to dinner. Tabloid-style but FIFA-clean.
seeds.research_prompt: Search [TEAM] + camp + leak / [TEAM] + hotel in local language press. The English press lags 24-48hr.
seeds.post_format: Single slide for fast-turn, or carousel if there are 3+ details.

seeds.angle: Federation-sponsor-fan triangulation. Every cycle has at least 3 kit controversies — colour choice, sponsor logo, religious imagery, sleeve advertising.
seeds.research_prompt: Search [TEAM] + kit + reaction / [TEAM] + jersey + controversy in last 30 days.
seeds.post_format: Single slide with kit image + the controversy headline. High share rate because the kit itself is the meme.

seeds.angle: Star players left out of squads. Final 26-man lists drop ~10 days before kickoff and there's always at least one furious omission per nation.
seeds.research_prompt: Compare announced 26-man squad vs market consensus pre-announcement. The gap is the story.
seeds.post_format: Carousel: 'The 5 biggest snubs of [WC 2026]'. This is the highest-share scandal format historically.

seeds.angle: Referee assignments. CONMEBOL fans accusing UEFA bias, UEFA fans accusing CONMEBOL bias, everyone accusing Saudi referees of bias — the meta-story of every WC.
seeds.research_prompt: Match-day -2: FIFA publishes ref assignments. Cross-reference ref's nationality against either team's recent grievances.
seeds.post_format: Single slide pre-match: 'Today's ref: [NAME], [NATIONALITY]. Last [TEAM] match: [RESULT + context].'

_authoring_tips: The scandal thread should be 10-20% of your total posting volume — too much and you tip from 'savvy account' into 'tabloid' and lose the stats credibility that makes the other content work. Pair every scandal post with a stats post the same day.
